stem.text: A tennis ball is released from rest at time $t = 0$ and falls through air for a long time.
Which graph of its displacement $s$ against time $t$ best represents the motion of the ball?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin 0, showing one curve.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin 0, showing one curve.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin 0, showing one curve.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin 0, showing one curve.
